The official website declares "MIT licensed". At this revision the upstream
packages/icons/package.json also declares "license": "MIT"; an unmodified copy
is preserved in third-party/icona/upstream-package.json. No standalone LICENSE
file is supplied upstream. LICENSE.txt reproduces the standard MIT terms with
attribution to Icona contributors; it is not represented as a copied upstream file.
The website footer attributes copyright to Icona.

Noteka selects local SVG Fill/bold variants and reuses the official Tasks
(checklist) Jelly CSS export across nine sidebar scenes. User-group,
user-plus, double-arrow, mirrored-sidebar and open-lock adaptations compose or
transform the official geometry. CSS triggers and iteration counts are adapted
for one explicit cycle. The same Jelly group transform wraps each selected
static SVG; Tasks' original exported scene is preserved. No particles are used.
No upstream website, fonts, brand artwork, React runtime or full icon library
is included in the application. Historical AnimateIcons notices are retained
separately for earlier releases; no AnimateIcons geometry is used by this catalog.
